verdict.rationale: Smooth publishes an official SDK repository (circlemind-ai/smooth-sdk). Its quickstart shows a client library call (`smooth_client.run(...)`), and the docs advertise running a task in about 4 lines of code. SDK-level features are also documented, including custom tools that register arbitrary functions, `response_model` structured outputs, and session methods. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of which languages are supported or whether more than one official SDK exists, a published SDK reference or OpenAPI spec (the probe found all OpenAPI paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
